walkthrough: 1. Swing — your left foot lifts off and swings forward, the knee bending toward about 6°.
2. Foot strike — it lands a little ahead of you, with the knee around 179° at contact.
3. Stance — your weight rolls over the planted foot; you spend roughly 50% of each step on the ground, and your body stays fairly level.
4. Push-off — that foot drives off behind you as the other foot begins its own swing, and the cycle repeats.
Overall a step lands about every 0.36s (~166 per minute) with a steady rhythm.

observations: Your hips dip from side to side a fair amount as you step.
